about: One row per published surface of the product (Roadmap IV, Appendix E): every page, generated family, route parameter, dialog, mode and shared region. Whether a page is in the sitemap or the offline tour, its walk row, outline record, gate id and destination are read from their own files and are in the Markdown view, not here. The definition columns come from tools/surface-ledger-seed.json; disposition, redesign, reason, sitemap_reason and decision are written by the prompt that closes the row. A row is OPEN until its owner closes it; DEFERRED with redesign FOUNDATIONS ONLY needs a decision row of the register.

scan.about: Files that read the address through URLSearchParams or searchParams and are not a reader of any route row, each with the reason.

ignored.reason: It builds the query string it sends to the CDS archive; it reads no part of the page address.
